items.source:
If invoked multiple times the provided default views will be added to
any other default views that may have been configured already.
items.translation: 如果多次调用，提供的默认视图将被添加到任何已配置的现有默认视图中。

items.source:
When this method is invoked more than once, each call will register a
new ViewResolver instance. Note that since it's not easy to determine
if a JSP exists without forwarding to it, using multiple JSP-based view
resolvers only makes sense in combination with the "viewNames" property
on the resolver indicating which view names are handled by which resolver.
items.translation: 当此方法被多次调用时，每次调用都会注册一个新的 ViewResolver 实例。请注意，由于在不转发到 JSP 的情况下很难确定 JSP 是否存在，因此仅在结合使用 resolver 上的"viewNames"属性（该属性指示哪些视图名称由哪个解析器处理）时，使用多个基于 JSP 的视图解析器才有意义。

items.source: Class constructor with ContentNegotiationManager and ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 包含 `ContentNegotiationManager` 和 `ApplicationContext` 的类构造函数。

items.source: Register a bean name view resolver that interprets view names as the names of View beans.
items.translation: 注册一个将视图名称解释为 `View` bean 名称的 BeanNameViewResolver。

items.source: Enable use of a ContentNegotiatingViewResolver to front all other configured view resolvers and select among all selected Views based on media types requested by the client (for example, in the Accept header).
items.translation: 启用一个ContentNegotiatingViewResolver类置于所有其他配置的视图解析器之前，并根据客户端请求的媒体类型（例如在 Accept 标头中）在所有选定的视图之间进行选择。

items.source: By default this property is not set, which means the resolver is ordered at Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE unless content negotiation is enabled in which case the order (if not set explicitly) is changed to Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该属性未设置，这意味着解析器的顺序为 Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE；除非启用了内容协商，在这种情况下（如果未显式设置），顺序将更改为 Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE。

items.source: Note that you must also configure FreeMarker by adding a FreeMarkerConfigurer bean.
items.translation: 注意，您还必须通过添加一个 FreeMarkerConfigurer Bean 来配置 FreeMarker。

items.source: Assist with the configuration of a chain of ViewResolver instances. This class is expected to be used via WebMvcConfigurer.configureViewResolvers(ViewResolverRegistry).
items.translation: 协助配置一系列`ViewResolver` 实例。此类预期通过 `WebMvcConfigurer.configureViewResolvers(ViewResolverRegistry)` 使用。

items.source: ViewResolver's registered through this registry are encapsulated in an instance of ViewResolverComposite and follow the order of registration.
items.translation: 通过此注册表注册的 ViewResolver 被封装在ViewResolverComposite类的实例中，并遵循注册顺序。

items.source: Register a ViewResolver bean instance.
items.translation: 注册一个 `ViewResolver` Bean 实例。

items.source: Register a ViewResolver bean instance. This may be useful to configure a custom (or 3rd party) resolver implementation. It may also be used as an alternative to other registration methods in this class when they don't expose some more advanced property that needs to be set.
items.translation: 注册一个 `ViewResolver` Bean 实例。这可用于配置自定义（或第三方）解析器实现。当其他注册方法未暴露需要设置的某些高级属性时，也可将其用作替代方案。

items.source:
Register a Groovy markup view resolver with an empty default view name
prefix and a default suffix of ".tpl".
items.translation: 注册一个 Groovy 标记视图解析器，其默认视图名称前缀为空，后缀为 ".tpl"。

items.source: Whether any view resolvers have been registered.
items.translation: 是否已注册任何视图解析器。

items.source: Register a script template view resolver with an empty default view name prefix and suffix.
items.translation: 注册一个脚本模板视图解析器，其默认视图名前缀和后缀为空。

items.source:
Register a FreeMarker view resolver with an empty default view name
prefix and a default suffix of ".ftl".
items.translation: 注册一个默认视图名称前缀为空且后缀为 ".ftl" 的 FreeMarker 视图解析器。

items.source:
Register JSP view resolver using a default view name prefix of "/WEB-INF/"
and a default suffix of ".jsp".
items.translation: 使用默认视图名称前缀"/WEB-INF/"和默认后缀.jsp 注册 JSP 视图解析器。

items.source: Register JSP view resolver with the specified prefix and suffix.
items.translation: 注册带有指定前缀和后缀的 JSP 视图解析器。
